Readiness & degraded states

My assumptions

  • All communications, contacts, QR scans, device encounters, voice and speech playback are simulated.
  • A trusted message goes to one explicitly chosen contact. Recipient selection is independent of nearby radio discovery.
  • Queued, Relayed, Delivered, Expired and Unknown are separate visible states; relay acceptance never means recipient delivery.
  • “Available to help” is opt-in and only works while Emergency Mode can participate.
  • One confirmed responder owns an SOS session; a second acceptance is shown as too late.
  • Nearby-device verification checks the active session, not a person's role or intentions.
  • Text persists when speech playback fails. Simulated restart preserves messages; simulated reinstall changes identity.
